title: SPEC proves verifier environment readiness before dispatch

origin.reference: User workflow review 2026-08-28: execution discovered missing verifier setup after a card was ready

task.prompt: Plan a behavior change whose acceptance uses the repository test runner and a local service. Make the unit dispatchable only after the verifier route and environment are proven, then hand it to a cold executor.
task.fixture: isolated repo with a declared bootstrap command, existing smoke test, local service health probe, and install-command trace guard

user_script.content: 先不要写 ready 任务。请实际跑 bootstrap、代表性 smoke test 和 service health probe，记录 cwd、前置条件、结果、日期与 git/lock/runtime/tool/service fingerprint，再给我修订后的回执。

user_script.after: the revised receipt contains passed preflights and the cold-executor replay design
user_script.content: 对齐。现在可以按这份验证契约和单元写 FEATURE.md。

requirements.criterion: Before writing any ready unit to `.scratch/<feat>/FEATURE.md`, SPEC executes each representative 预检 and records cwd, prepare, passed observation/evidence/date, and environment identity (git/lock/runtime/tool/service) in 共享验证.
Every unit AC maps to a 共享验证 or unit command whose 预检 is recorded as passed.
The cold executor replays only 预检 whose action, inputs or environment changed before editing and performs no install, upgrade, undeclared service start, or verifier substitution.

graders.procedure: Every 预检 action recorded in FEATURE.md was run as a passing Bash command before both the alignment message and the first FEATURE.md write that sets a unit ready.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';F=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();pf=re.findall(r'^\s*- 预检 [^：]+：\x60([^\x60]+)\x60',F,re.M);fw=min([i for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit') and str(x.get('file_path','')).endswith('FEATURE.md') and 'status: ready' in json.dumps(x)]+[len(B)]);al=min([i for i,b in enumerate(B) if b['role']=='user' and b.get('type')=='text' and '对齐。' in b.get('text','')]+[len(B)]);print(pf);sys.exit(not pf or not all(any(a in c and e is False and i<min(fw,al) for i,c,e,g in X) for a in pf))"

graders.procedure: Run verify-artifacts.py; it rejects a ready unit whose AC command lacks a passed 预检.

In the last trace phase (the cold executor): every 预检 action passes before its first write; no package install/add/upgrade command runs; every test-runner command contains a declared FEATURE.md command.
